description: Search 36M+ biomedical and life science articles — clinical trials, reviews, meta-analyses with date and type filters (PubMed/NCBI)

date_from.description: Start date filter in YYYY/MM/DD format (e.g. "2023/01/01").

date_to.description: End date filter in YYYY/MM/DD format (e.g. "2024/12/31").

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50). Default: 10.

query.description: Search text for biomedical literature (e.g. "COVID-19 vaccine efficacy", "BRCA1 breast cancer").

name: education.pubmed.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search PubMed
